story.title: Story 4: Smart Compact Snapshot And Rollout Regeneration

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 4 against the story spec, the full SQLite persistence tech design, and the test plan; then traced the production smart-compact path from runSmartCompact through SQLite snapshot reads, projection/materialization, metadata persistence, and the new SQLite-focused tests. I also ran the configured story gate (`npm run verify-all`) and an ad-hoc mixed-snapshot repro to validate the compact-read-consistency claim.

newFindings.title: Smart compact still re-reads live thread/chunk state after taking the SQLite compact snapshot
newFindings.evidence: `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-builder.ts:886-990` reads `readCompactSnapshot(...)`, but then hands only `threadId` + `draftView` to `ThreadViewMaterializer`. `src/thread-view/services/thread-view-materializer.ts:691-700` immediately calls `openThread()` and `readChunks()` again, outside the single SQLite read transaction established in `src/thread/store/sqlite-thread-store.ts:1015-1033`. That means selected IDs can come from one snapshot while rendered message/chunk content comes from a later store read. The new SQLite regression test at `tests/commands/smart-compact-sqlite.test.ts:93-123` only appends a brand-new message after the snapshot, so it does not cover mutations to already-selected rows. An ad-hoc repro on 2026-05-26 mutated a selected smooth component after `readCompactSnapshot` and produced `{"sourceRevision":8,"snapshotReadRevision":8,"containsPostSnapshotText":true}`, proving the generated rollout can include post-snapshot content.

productionPathFindings: No fake adapter, shim, or placeholder branch was found in the reviewed smart-compact SQLite path; the blocking defect is in real production code where `ThreadViewMaterializer` re-reads live store state after snapshot selection.
additionalObservations: The configured gate passed, so the blocker is a semantic consistency defect rather than a failing lint/type/test/build gate.

The new SQLite-focused tests do cover source-vs-rollout truth, strict-vs-prepare behavior, and regeneration, but the compact-read-consistency case currently only exercises post-snapshot message append and misses post-snapshot mutations to already-selected turns/chunks.
